intro: {{nameA}} and {{nameB}} both appear on this {{course}} page, and our table records both in {{cityA}}. This page compares recorded fees, placements and exams from our database and official sites opened in {{year}}.

GIBS Business School vs Regional College of Management should not be read from the ₹25,000 GIBS row, which is an admission fee, not tuition. Also confirm you have the right Regional College of Management campus, because similarly named institutes exist in other cities.

sections.heading: GIBS Business School vs Regional College of Management for MBA / PGDM: which is better in 2026
paragraphs: Choose GIBS if you want a PGDM at the recorded year tuition of ₹4.50 lakh, with a 2023 HR row of ₹5 lakh average and ₹16 lakh highest, and a CAT or NMAT route on our records.
Choose Regional College of Management if you want the recorded MBA year total of ₹4.30 lakh and the ATMA route, after you confirm the official campus and a placement report newer than 2021.

sections.heading: Fees: what our records show, and what to watch
paragraphs: For GIBS we hold ₹4.50 lakh as tuition for one year on several PGDM rows, plus a ₹25,000 admission fee. Do not quote the admission fee as the programme cost.
For Regional College of Management we hold ₹4.30 lakh as a Total Fees year figure across several dual-specialisation MBA rows. That is a year amount, not a confirmed two-year official total.
Confirm the current notices on gibs.edu.in and the official Regional College of Management site before you budget.

sections.heading: Placements compared
paragraphs: GIBS has a 2023 PGDM Human Resource row of ₹5 lakh average and ₹16 lakh highest, plus earlier 2021 and 2020 rows. These are historical records, not promises.

Regional College of Management has a 2021 PGDM International Business row of ₹7 lakh average and ₹45 lakh highest, and a 2019 MBA row. The ₹45 lakh highest is a recorded 2021 figure; ask the institute for the official report before you rely on it.
Use year-matched, programme-matched reports. Do not compare a 2023 GIBS average with a 2021 highest package as if they were the same thing.

sections.heading: Admission and eligibility
paragraphs: GIBS is listed with CAT and NMAT. Regional College of Management is listed with ATMA. Confirm the current exam list on the official admissions pages.
GIBS lists several PGDM titles. Regional College of Management lists dual-specialisation MBA titles. Match the exact programme, not only the MBA label.

sections.heading: Location and campus
paragraphs: Our table records both campuses in Bangalore. Confirm the official address, especially for Regional College of Management, because institutes with a similar name also operate elsewhere.
A campus visit, or at least a check of the official address, is useful before you pay an admission fee.

sections.heading: Verdict: who should pick which college
paragraphs: Pick GIBS if the recorded ₹4.50 lakh year tuition, the 2023 placement row, and the CAT or NMAT route fit your plan.
Pick Regional College of Management if the recorded ₹4.30 lakh year total and the ATMA route fit, after you have confirmed the campus and a later official placement report.
Do not decide from the ₹25,000 admission fee or from a single 2021 highest package.

faqs.question: Is the GIBS PGDM fee only ₹25,000?
faqs.answer: No. The ₹25,000 row is an admission fee. Recorded tuition is ₹4.50 lakh for one year. Use the official GIBS notice for the current total.

faqs.question: What MBA fee is on record for Regional College of Management?
faqs.answer: We hold ₹4.30 lakh as a Total Fees year figure on several dual-specialisation MBA rows. That is not a confirmed two-year official total.

faqs.question: How do placements compare?
faqs.answer: GIBS has a 2023 HR row of ₹5 lakh average and ₹16 lakh highest. Regional College of Management has a 2021 international-business row of ₹7 lakh average and ₹45 lakh highest. Ask for the official 2021 report before you rely on that highest figure.

faqs.question: Which exams do these programmes accept?
faqs.answer: GIBS is listed with CAT and NMAT. Regional College of Management is listed with ATMA. Confirm the current list on the official admissions pages.

faqs.question: Is Regional College of Management definitely in Bangalore?
faqs.answer: That is how our table records it. Confirm the official address before you apply, because institutes with a similar name also operate in other cities.

faqs.question: Are these programmes both two-year management courses?
faqs.answer: Yes, on our records: GIBS lists PGDM titles, and Regional College of Management lists dual-specialisation MBA titles. Match the exact programme in the official brochure.
